استخبرن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْبَرْنَ (istaḵbarna) /is.tax.bar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اُسْتُخْبِرْنَ (ustuḵbirna) /us.tux.bir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# اِسْتَخْبِرْنَ (istaḵbirna) /is.tax.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
